metadata.description: Ray Amjad's Claude Code mods: panes, bands, prompt guards and memory tools, each one installable on its own.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: A one-line band above the prompt: context used, and a countdown until the prompt cache goes cold

plugins.name: decision-tree
plugins.description: When Claude ends a reply with a question, explains the choice in a side pane and lets you explore any option, or your own, in a real forked session

plugins.name: diagram-pane
plugins.description: A side pane that pins every diagram Claude draws, keeps a live map of the work, and lets you go into boxes and change them

plugins.name: dream-pass
plugins.description: A dreaming pass over Claude's memory folder: merges duplicates, rewrites stale entries, removes dead ones and tidies MEMORY.md, with a backup and undo

plugins.name: jev-skill-suggestion
plugins.description: Scores every skill against your prompt with TypeSafe Jev as you type; observe, block or steer skill loading

plugins.name: memory-fork
plugins.description: After each turn Haiku decides whether memory needs a change; a tool-less fork of the session drafts it and the mod writes it, with a band and a pane showing what changed

plugins.name: prompt-bouncer
plugins.description: Bounces vague prompts before Claude sees them, and suggests the project's own term

plugins.name: secret-box
plugins.description: Claude can use a secret without seeing it: a masked box saves keys to .env and gives Claude a placeholder, every key a tool prints comes back as a placeholder, and committing .env is refused

plugins.name: transcript-redactor
plugins.description: Keeps secrets and email addresses out of the session transcript: swaps each one for a stable placeholder on the way in, and puts the real value back on the way into a tool call

plugins.name: vercel-deploy-status
plugins.description: Pins the Vercel deploy queue of the linked project under the prompt: every deploy queued, building or just finished, with its phase and elapsed time
